title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
summary: Mathematicians are having their minds blown by the latest AI-driven result — and there's a competing human solution, too.
llm_summary: A new AI system announced that it had cracked the 167‑year‑old Riemann Hypothesis, sparking a wave of excitement (and skepticism) among mathematicians. At the same time, a human researcher released a separate proof that also claims to solve the problem, prompting a lively debate over which, if either, is correct.
